title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
partTitle: Identity Is Discovered Within the Body of Christ
summaryZh: 神透過群體與當季的信息塑造我們的身分，彼此相交也需要付上代價。
lines: I believe that the teachings of the apostles are those themes that God emphasizes at a particular time period.
我相信，使徒的教訓就是神在特定時期所強調的主題。

You have noticed that we may have half a dozen speakers in three months, and there will be similarities in their words, not because there was a plan, but because there is inspiration from the Father who thinks, and He helps His children discover these thoughts and communicate them.
你們可能注意到，我們三個月內會有六位左右的講員，他們所說的話會有相似之處；這不是事先安排好的，而是因為父神有祂的心意，祂幫助祂的兒女發現這些意念，並把它們傳達出來。
We can invite a speaker from South Africa, and he will come and say something very similar. Why?
我們可以邀請一位來自南非的講員，他來了以後也會說出非常相似的內容。為什麼呢？
For we are connected to one and the same Father.
因為我們都連結於同一位父神。
You could say, “This is the teaching of the apostles; this is the theme for this season.”
你可以說：「這是使徒的教訓，也是這個季節的主題。」
And they continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching.
他們都恆心遵守使徒的教訓。
You must be present to hear the themes that God orchestrates, designs, and proclaims over people in a particular season.
你必須親自參與，才能聽見神在特定季節中為人安排、設計並宣告的主題。
Because part of our identity is formed through hearing these words.
因為我們的身分有一部分，是藉著聽見這些話而形成的。
When I last spoke to you, I think it was a couple of weeks ago, I was talking about the 10 spies who brought bad news.
我上次跟你們講道，我想是幾週前，當時我在講那十個帶回壞消息的探子。
Two weeks ago, I talked about 10 scouts.
兩週前，我講過十個探子。
If you haven’t been, please listen to this.
如果你那時沒來，請聽聽那篇信息。
I told you about 10 scouts; they are still alive.
我跟你們講過那十個探子；他們現在還活著。
Those 10 spies who brought the bad news convinced, say, 2 million people to turn away from God’s promise.
那十個帶回壞消息的探子，說服了大約兩百萬人轉離神的應許。
They thought they were hearing words of wisdom, and they were grateful that those words of wisdom had saved them from imminent disaster.
他們以為自己聽見的是智慧之言，也很感激那些話讓他們免於迫在眉睫的災難。
But in reality, these words distanced them from their potential and promise.
但實際上，這些話使他們遠離自己的潛能和應許。
Often, words of caution seem like words of wisdom, but in reality they are words of fear, and the enemy has exploited this.
警戒的話常常聽起來像智慧之言，但實際上它們是出於恐懼的話，而仇敵一直利用這一點。
What was part of that story?
這個故事裡還有什麼呢？
The fact that Israel did not enter the promised land was because they saw themselves as locusts.
以色列人沒有進入應許之地，是因為他們看自己像蚱蜢。
“We were like grasshoppers in our own eyes, and so we were in their eyes.”
「我們看自己就像蚱蜢一樣，在他們眼中也是如此。」
And then you read the story where Rahab in Jericho says, “We have been afraid of you for 40 years.”
接著你會讀到耶利哥的喇合說：「我們四十年來一直害怕你們。」
“Our people have been discouraged all this time because of you.”
「因為你們的緣故，我們的百姓這段時間一直灰心喪膽。」
They saw themselves through the prism of the size of their enemy, not according to what God said when He gave them the promise.
他們透過敵人的強大來看自己，而不是按照神賜下應許時所說的話來看自己。
And when God defines you and me as members of each other, there is a depth to it that can only be discovered through sacrifice.
當神定義你我彼此都是身體上的肢體時，其中有一層深度，唯有透過犧牲才能發現。
Let me rephrase that to make it sound more appealing.
讓我換個說法，讓它聽起來更吸引人。
You see, there is something special about community.
你看，群體生活有它特別之處。
In Hebrews 13, fellowship is actually called a sacrifice, which tells me: I cannot fully know who I am as a member of the body of Christ until my fellowship costs me something.
在希伯來書第十三章，彼此相交確實被稱為一種祭；這讓我明白，在彼此相交需要我付上代價以前，我無法完全認識自己作為基督身體肢體的身分。
If I only do what is convenient, then I am in control of everything.
如果我只做方便的事，那一切就都由我掌控。
And this is no longer the rule of Jesus, but the rule of my religious views.
這樣一來，掌權的就不再是耶穌，而是我自己的宗教觀念。
